answer: Admission auctions stop agents that forge identities. Each epoch, 100 work slots go to the highest bidders, each bid signed with the agent's quill, an uncopyable signature. Winners lock twice 30 days' expected earnings for 20 epochs. To forge 1,000 identities, an attacker must outbid honest agents 1,000 times: at 50 POA a slot, that is 50,000 POA locked up front. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot; the tundra leaves fakes with nothing.
